_comment: RCF English - single source of truth for site-wide settings. Edit the values below, then run build.cmd. See HOW-TO-UPDATE.md.
tagline: Learn clearly. Practise confidently. Progress steadily.
shortDescription: Clear English lessons, practical revision resources and reliable teaching support for learners and teachers.
_siteUrlNote: The custom domain. Used for canonical URLs, Open Graph tags and sitemap.xml. Page-to-page links are relative, so the site still works at any address, but search engines are told this is the real one. The CNAME file in the project root must hold the same domain - GitHub Pages reads it from there.
_publicationsNote: Replace the placeholder above with the published address of the RCF Publications bookshop, for example https://satarajayamaga-afk.github.io/rcf-ebook-publications/ . Nothing else needs to change - every publications link on the site reads this one value.
_analyticsNote: Visitor statistics. Leave id empty and no statistics script is added to any page. For Cloudflare Web Analytics (free, no cookies): sign in at dash.cloudflare.com, open Analytics & Logs > Web Analytics, add the site rcfenglish.com, choose the JavaScript snippet, and copy only the token value from it into id. For GoatCounter instead, set provider to goatcounter and id to your site code (the xxx in xxx.goatcounter.com). Then run build.cmd. The privacy policy switches its wording automatically.
buildNote: Generated files are written to the project root by tools/build-site.ps1. Do not edit generated .html files by hand - your changes would be overwritten on the next build.
